hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.astro) npx eslint --no-warn-ignored --max-warnings=0 "$f" >&2 || exit 2;; esac
[ "$(jq -r '.stop_hook_active')" = "true" ] && exit 0; git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | grep -qE '\.(ts|tsx|astro)$' || exit 0; npm run type-check >&2 || exit 2
